slides.title: Press Releases for SEO? *Read This First*

slides.text: Google lists links with *"optimized anchor text in … press releases"* distributed on other sites as *link spam*.

items: Anchor "cheap SEO services Manila" in every paragraph
A release with no news, just for the link
A dozen links in one release
Brand name or URL as the anchor

slides.title: So What Are Release Links *Worth*?
slides.body: Three real things: **referral traffic** from readers, **brand mentions** on news sites that help people recognize you, and **follow-up coverage** from journalists who find your release.

slides.title: rel="sponsored" Is *Normal*
slides.body: Google asks for paid or placed links to carry **rel="sponsored"** or **nofollow**. So judge a release by who reads it and who writes about it next, not by "link juice".
slides.src: Google Search Central, Qualify outbound links

slides.title: An *SEO-Safe* Release Checklist
items: Keywords appear naturally in the headline, not stuffed
One main link to a relevant page
Data or a quote other media will want to cite
Track brand mentions, not just link counts

slides.title: Good PR *Helps* SEO. Not the Other Way Around.

captions_meta.hook: Sending press releases for backlinks? Google has a policy on that. 🔗
lines: Google lists optimized anchor text in press releases distributed on other sites as link spam.
The real value: referral traffic, brand mentions and organic coverage.
captions_meta.li_hook:
"Send a press release to get backlinks" is a tactic Google names specifically in its spam policies.
Here is how to use releases for SEO without the risk.
li_body: In its Spam policies documentation, Google Search Central lists links with optimized anchor text in articles, guest posts or press releases distributed on other sites as an example of link spam. It also asks for paid or placed links to be qualified with rel="sponsored" or nofollow.
Does that make releases useless for SEO? Quite the opposite, as long as you measure the right things:
li_points: Referral traffic from readers who click through.
Brand mentions on news sites that strengthen how your entity is recognized.
Organic coverage from journalists who find the release and write their own story. That is where the biggest SEO value sits.
Safe practice: brand/URL anchors, one main link, and news genuinely worth citing.
captions_meta.li_close: How does your team measure the SEO impact of releases today?
captions_meta.fb: Lots of teams send press releases just for backlinks. Before you do, here is what Google actually says 👇
